paragraphs.text: 1. O KING, the potent and terrific envoy, kindled for strength, is manifest in beauty.
paragraphs.original: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि ।
paragraphs.translit: ino rājannaratiḥ samiddho raudro dakṣāya suṣumām̐ adarśi |

paragraphs.text: He shines, all-knowing, with his lofty splendour: chasing black Night he comes with white-rayed Morning.
2. Having o'ercome the glimmering Black with beauty, and bringing forth the dame the Great Sire's Daughter,
paragraphs.original: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसा भूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: kṛṣṇāṃ yadenīmabhi varpasā bhūjjanayanyoṣāṃ bṛhataḥ piturjām |

paragraphs.text: Holding aloft the radiant light of Surya, as messenger of heaven he shines with treasures.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति
paragraphs.translit: ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ sūryasya stabhāyandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhāti

paragraphs.text: 3. Attendant on the Blessed Dame the Blessed hath come: the Lover followeth his Sister.
paragraphs.original: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् ।
paragraphs.translit: bhadro bhadrayā sacamāna āgātsvasāraṃ jāro abhyeti paścāt |

paragraphs.text: Agni, far-spreading with conspicuous lustre, hath compassed Night with whitely shining garments.
4. His goings-forth kindle as 'twere high voices the goings of the auspicious Friend of Agni.
paragraphs.original: अस्य यामासो बृहतो न वग्नूनिन्धाना अग्नेः सख्युः शिवस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: asya yāmāso bṛhato na vagnūnindhānā agneḥ sakhyuḥ śivasya |

paragraphs.text: The rays, the bright beams of the strong-jawed, mighty, adorable Steer are visible as he cometh.
paragraphs.original: ईड्यस्य वृष्णो बृहतः स्वासो भामासो यामन्नक्तवश्चिकित्रे
paragraphs.translit: īḍyasya vṛṣṇo bṛhataḥ svāso bhāmāso yāmannaktavaścikitre

paragraphs.text: 5. Whose radiant splendours flow, like sounds, about us, his who is lofty, brilliant, and effulgent,
paragraphs.original: स्वना न यस्य भामासः पवन्ते रोचमानस्य बृहतः सुदिवः ।
paragraphs.translit: svanā na yasya bhāmāsaḥ pavante rocamānasya bṛhataḥ sudivaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who reaches heaven with best and brightest lustres, sportive and piercing even to the summit.
6. His powers, whose chariot fellies gleam and glitter have loudly roared while, as with teams, he hasted.
He, the most Godlike, far-extending envoy, shines with flames ancient, resonant, whitely-shining.
7. So bring us ample wealth: seat thee as envoy of the two youthful Matrons, Earth and Heaven.
paragraphs.original: स आ वक्षि महि न आ च सत्सि दिवस्पृथिव्योररतिर्युवत्योः ।
paragraphs.translit: sa ā vakṣi mahi na ā ca satsi divaspṛthivyoraratiryuvatyoḥ |

paragraphs.text: Let Agni rapid with his rapid, horses, impetuous with impetuous Steeds, come hither.
paragraphs.original: अग्निः सुतुकः सुतुकेभिरश्वै रभस्वद्भी रभस्वाँ एह गम्याः
paragraphs.translit: agniḥ sutukaḥ sutukebhiraśvai rabhasvadbhī rabhasvām̐ eha gamyāḥ
